Honors and Awards
 
  1. Awarded “Energy and Energized award” for outstanding contribution to technology development in India at Asia-Pacific Technology Development conference (MONSANTO INDIA LIMITED) held at Chiang Mai (Thailand) during Feb. 2005.
  2. Appreciation  award for data management initiatives in India at Asia-Pacific Technology Development conference (MONSANTO INDIA LIMITED) held at  Chiang Mai (Thailand) during Feb. 2005. 
  3. Awarded  General Gold Medal for the year 1998 in recognition of having secured the first position in B. Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.
  4. Awarded "Haxamar Foundation" Gold Medal for the year 2000 in recognition of having secured highest O.G.P.A. in M. Sc. (Ag.)  examination in subject of Entomology. 
  5. Winner of  Merit Fellowships during B.Sc., M.Sc. & Ph.D.
  6. Received Best monitoring, planning and documentation centre for 2012-13 in the All India coordinated research project on Honey bees and pollinators
  7. Received Best Performing Main Centre Award for the year 2015-16 for outstanding work on Rapeseed-mustard crops in Annual Group Meeting of AICRP (R&M) was held on Aug 5-7,  2016 at DUVASU, Mathura, Uttar Pradesh.
  8. Received  second prize for best poster in International symposium on “Innopreneurship: A need of sustainable Agriculture” organized by CCS HAU, Hisar from 2-3  Feb., 2019
  9. Awarded third prize for oral presentation in Theme 4 in National Conference on “Priorities in Crop        Protection for Sustainable Agriculture” organized by Central Agricultural University, Imphal, Manipur and ICAR-National Bureau of  Agricultural Insect Resources, Bengaluru from 16-18 March, 2021
